description: MUMmer 3.23 show-tiling: places the aligned query contigs of a delta file on the reference. For every contig and reference the longest consistent subset of its alignments (maxGap -g, default 1000 for nucmer files / -1 for promer) is taken; a contig is tiled when its coverage is at least minCoverage (-v, default 95) and better than the second best by minCoverageDifference (-V, default 10) and its identity at least minIdentity (-i, default 90), or, when it hangs over the reference ends, by the same rule on the overhang-corrected coverage; contigs shorter than minContigLength (-l) are ignored. The tiled contigs are linked along each reference (circular = -c lets them span the origin) and printed as '>refId N bases' followed by 'start end gapToNext length coverage identity strand id' (the tiling path), or with printAlignments (-a) as the tab-delimited alignment rows, or with xml (-x) as the XML link evidence. contigList (-t), unusable (-u) and pseudoMolecule (-p, needs the query FASTA) return the program's files. randomRepeats (-R) places repetitive contigs at a random copy (rand() seeded by randomSeed; the program uses the current time; implies minCoverageDifference 0). Byte for byte equal to the installed show-tiling on 350 + runs.

queryFasta.description: Query FASTA text (only needed for pseudoMolecule).

printAlignments.description: -a: print the alignment rows of the tiling path (default false).

maxGap.description: -g: maximum gap between clustered alignments, -1 = infinity (nucmer default 1000, promer -1).

minIdentity.description: -i: minimum percent identity to tile, 0 - 100 (nucmer default 90, promer 55).

randomRepeats.description: -R: place repetitive contigs at a random one of their copies (default false).

minCoverage.description: -v: minimum contig coverage to tile, 0 - 100 (nucmer default 95, promer 50).

minCoverageDifference.description: -V: minimum contig coverage difference, 0 - 100 (nucmer default 10, promer 30).

xml.description: -x: print the XML contig linking information (default false).

contigList.description: -t: also return the TIGR-style contig list (default false).

unusable.description: -u: also return the alignment rows of the unusable contigs (default false).

pseudoMolecule.description: -p: also return the pseudo molecule of the query contigs (default false).

randomSeed.description: Seed of rand() for -R (the program uses the current time); default = the current time.

text.description: The tiling path (or the alignment rows / XML) written to standard output.

errors.message: Delta file text cannot be null or empty
ERROR: Percentages must be within the range [0.0, 100.0]

examples.name: Two contigs tiled on one reference
